list.name: DS_TEMPO
list.label: Trace backend (Tempo, LangSmith-OTLP, or any OTLP-compatible store)

panels.title: 1. Total request count — chat.request root spans
panels.description: Backing signal: count of `chat.request` root spans (backend-derived). TraceQL below lists matching traces; row count over the selected time range is the total request count. A backend with native TraceQL metrics can instead graph `{ name = "chat.request" } | count_over_time()`.

panels.title: 2. Error rate — chat.request span status
panels.description: Backing signal: `chat.request` span status / `error.type` (backend-derived). TraceQL below isolates error-status root spans; error rate = this panel's row count / panel 1's row count over the same window. OTel's default `use_span` behavior sets ERROR status (no message, no recorded exception — T014's PHI rule) on any chat.request span an unhandled exception escapes.

panels.title: 3. p50 / p95 latency — chat.request span duration
panels.description: Backing signal: `chat.request` span start/end time (backend-derived). Table includes a Duration column per trace; apply Grafana's built-in percentile/Reduce transform, or (on a backend with TraceQL metrics) graph `{ name = "chat.request" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .5, .95)`.

panels.title: 4. Tool-call counts — tool.call spans + tool_failure_total
panels.description: Backing signal: count of `tool.call` spans, broken out by `tool.name`/`outcome` attribute, plus `/metrics`'s `tool_failure_total` counter (see panel 8's note on wiring the /metrics JSON endpoint as a data source).

panels.title: 5. Token cost — llm.call span llm.cost_usd
panels.description: Backing signal: `llm.call` span's `llm.cost_usd` attribute (exact Decimal string; absent, never zero, when usage/pricing is unknown — T014). Sum/average this column for total/average spend.

panels.title: 6. Verification pass/fail — verify.response claim counts
panels.description: Backing signal: `verify.response` span's `verify.claims_total` / `verify.claims_passed` attributes (T008/T009). Pass rate = sum(claims_passed) / sum(claims_total) over the window.

options.content: **Backing signal**: `chat.request` root-span start/end concurrency — *derived*, not a literal attribute (T028 pre-spec). No backend queried during this ticket computes true span-overlap concurrency without an extra recording rule; on Tempo, approximate via the metrics-generator's `traces_service_graph_request_total` / span-metrics duration histogram cross-referenced with request rate (panel 1) and average latency (panel 3): `in_flight ≈ rate(requests) × avg(duration)` (Little's Law). If the chosen backend cannot compute real overlap, an in-process gauge would be a T014 amendment — out of this ticket's scope; flagged, not built here.

**Backing signal**: `/metrics`'s `llm_corrective_retry_total` counter (T039), alongside `tool_failure_total` (panel 4) and `audit_delivery_success_total` / `audit_delivery_failure_total`. `/metrics` returns plain JSON, not Prometheus exposition format — point a scrape adapter or Grafana's JSON API datasource plugin at it (`GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS=marcusolsson-json-datasource`) to graph it over time; documented in `docs/observability/README.md` rather than wired live in this file, since it needs one extra (undeployed-by-default) Grafana plugin.
